comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Verified labels persist after refresh in production verification.

content.text: Verified labels persist after refresh in production verification.
Triage labels applied through bulk action appear immediately but disappear after a page refresh.
Single-ticket label edits persist correctly, isolating the issue to the bulk write path or its response handling.
Ensure bulk label mutations commit and invalidate list caches so refresh shows the same labels agents just applied.
